title: AI-Driven Approaches in Reinforcement and Supervised Learning

contributions.purpose: 结合预训练网络特征与经典 ML 做可解释监督学习
contributions.mechanism: 用 ResNet-50 抽图像嵌入,再套 SVM/kNN/随机森林,交叉验证调参
contributions.evaluation: Table 1 占位式数字:SVM 准确率 0.92/精确 0.91/召回 0.90,kNN 0.89,随机森林 0.90(未指明数据集)

contributions.source_quote: Pre-trained ResNet-50 is employed for feature extraction. ... Classical ML methods such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) are applied on these features.

contributions.purpose: 在自建环境用 Q-learning 训练 RL 智能体
contributions.mechanism: 离散动作空间自定义环境 + 神经网络逼近 Q 函数,追踪累计奖励
contributions.evaluation: Table 2 占位式:累计奖励 120.5±8.2,回合长度 50±5(无环境/任务说明)
contributions.source_quote: The agent uses Q-learning with neural network approximators for the Q-function. Cumulative rewards are tracked across episodes.
